machine_shape.accepting: unique ascending integer array after admission

trace_shape.later: symbol is literal'0' or'1'; moved is raw symbol-destination union, active is its epsilon closure

dfa_shape.states: BFS0-before1 list of {id,members,accepting,zero,one,witness}; idsD0,D1,...; zero/one reference ids; witness first shortest BFS word

analysis_shape.dfaPath: ids including initial D0, then one per consumed symbol

semantics: Every member/moved/active set is canonical ascending. Duplicate or invalid input state indices are refused. Caller inputs are not mutated. This is only an interface supplement; no candidate body or result.
